---
# ============================================================================
# ERN research page. Edit the copy here, then rebuild:
#
#     python3 code/build_research_data.py    # only when the bibliography changes
#     quarto render research.qmd
#
# That overwrites research.html in place. git is the safety net — review
# `git diff research.html` before committing.
#
# The page chrome lives in _extensions/ern/research/template.html. Everything
# a person normally wants to change (headings, blurbs, links, footer) is a
# field below, so the template should rarely need touching.
#
# NOTE: values here are parsed as Markdown. Write &#39; for a straight
# apostrophe, which is what the rest of the site uses. Do not backslash-escape:
# inside a folded block scalar (>-) YAML keeps the backslash and it lands on
# the page. Colons and URLs need no escaping.
#
# The library&#39;s 206 entries are NOT in this file. They live in
# assets/data/research.json and are compiled to assets/data/research-data.js.
# ============================================================================

title: "Research and evidence on eviction — Eviction Research Network"

meta:
  canonical: "https://evictionresearch.net/research.html"
  author: "Eviction Research Network, UC Berkeley"
  og_title: "Research and evidence on eviction — Eviction Research Network"
  og_image: "https://evictionresearch.net/images/ern_logo/1Av2/EvictionStudy_logo_v09_1A_LOGO_BANNER.png"
  description: >-
    A searchable library of 206 publications, reports, and datasets on
    eviction, displacement, and housing precarity from researchers across the
    field, plus ERN&#39;s own published work. The policy evidence lives on its
    own page, What works.
  short_description: >-
    A searchable library of 206 publications on eviction and displacement,
    plus ERN&#39;s own published work.
  keywords: >-
    eviction research library, eviction publications, housing research,
    displacement, housing precarity, eviction data, Eviction Research Network

logos:
  logo: "images/ern_logo/1Av2/EvictionStudy_logo_v09_1A_LOGO_BANNER.png"
  logo_reversed: "images/ern_logo/1Av2/EvictionStudy_logo_v09_1A_LOGO_BANNER_REV.png"
  logo_stacked_reversed: "images/ern_logo/1A/EvictionStudy_logo_v09_1A_LOGO_STACK_REV.png"

# newtab: true on anything that leaves the site. current: true marks this page
# for screen readers and gives the nav item its red weight.
nav:
  - label: "Maps &amp; Profiles"
    href: "index.html#atlas"
  - label: "HPRM"
    href: "https://evictionresearch.net/hprm/"
    newtab: true
  - label: "Research"
    href: "research.html"
    current: true
  - label: "What works"
    href: "policy.html"
  - label: "About"
    href: "about.html"
  - label: "Contact"
    href: "mailto:evictions@berkeley.edu?Subject=Contact%20through%20website"
    button: true

hero:
  eyebrow: "Research"
  h1_lead: "Research and evidence"
  h1_em: "on eviction."
  lede: >-
    A searchable library of everything we can find on eviction, displacement,
    and housing precarity, and what ERN itself has published, built, or
    evaluated. For the policies with measured effects on eviction, see
    <a href="policy.html">What works</a>.
  # The count that precedes this line is rendered from library.count_in_prose.
  meta: >-
    entries in the library · Library last updated October 2026
  jump:
    - label: "Research library"
      href: "#library"
    - label: "What works — the policy evidence"
      href: "policy.html"

# ERN&#39;s own output. The library further down indexes the field&#39;s published
# work, four Tim Thomas papers among it, but it is not a catalogue of ERN&#39;s
# projects and datasets. Without this section the home page&#39;s "All research"
# button would land on a page that presents none of ERN&#39;s own work as such.
# These three cards are the same ones the home page carries.
ours:
  h2_lead: "From"
  h2_em: "ERN."
  sub: >-
    What we have published, built, or evaluated ourselves.
  more_label: "Read more →"
  cards:
    - kicker: "Working paper · 2026"
      title: >-
        Keeping People in Their Homes: the impact of emergency rental
        assistance on evictions
      body: >-
        A neighborhood-level evaluation of whether $46.6 billion in emergency
        rental assistance reduced eviction filings, across 700+ counties and
        12,000+ census tracts in 22 states.
      href: "https://evictionresearch.net/hud-era/"
    - kicker: "State profile · 2026"
      title: "Washington eviction filings, 2016–2026"
      body: >-
        Over the past 36 months, 1 in 45 renter households faced an eviction
        filing, roughly 49% above the pre-pandemic normal. Seven of 39 counties
        exceed the state rate.
      href: "https://evictionresearch.net/washington/"
    - kicker: "Cityscape (HUD) · 2024"
      title: >-
        Toward a national eviction data collection strategy using natural
        language processing
      body: >-
        How ERN mined 111,740 Washington court records buried in scanned PDFs
        and handwritten paper to expose the racial and gender disparities
        structured data could not see.
      href: "cityscape-2024.html"
  button:
    label: "Every state&#39;s data →"
    href: "eviction-data-atlas.html"

# The seven-policy evidence brief that used to sit here moved to its own
# page in August 2026: policy.qmd (What works), reorganized under the four
# P&#39;s. Several of its statistics failed verification and were replaced
# there rather than carried.

library:
  eyebrow: "Research library"
  h2_lead: "Everything we can find"
  h2_em: "on eviction."
  sub: >-
    Peer-reviewed publications, reports, working papers, and datasets on
    eviction, displacement, and housing precarity, from researchers, courts,
    agencies, and advocacy organizations across the field. Searchable by state,
    topic, and type. Know of work that belongs here?
    <a href="mailto:evictions@berkeley.edu?Subject=Library%20submission">Send it to us</a>.
  # Checked against assets/data/research.json by code/build_research_data.py on
  # every run. If the two disagree the script says so; fix this number, do not
  # fix the script.
  count_in_prose: 206
  search_placeholder: "Search by title, author, or publisher"
  all_states_label: "All states"
  all_topics_label: "All topics"
  all_types_label: "All types"
  loading_label: "Loading the library…"
  empty_label: "No publications match those filters. Try broadening the search."

contribute:
  eyebrow: "Add to the record"
  heading: "Know eviction work that is missing here?"
  body: >-
    The library is hand-maintained and it is incomplete by definition. If you
    have published research, run a court data project, or maintain a tracker we
    have not indexed, send it over and we will add it. If you need a policy
    briefing for a hearing or a bill, we write those too.
  primary:
    label: "Submit a publication →"
    href: "mailto:evictions@berkeley.edu?Subject=Library%20submission"
  secondary:
    label: "See how we work →"
    href: "methodology.html"

site_footer:
  # Canonical wording from library/ORG.md. Do not paraphrase, and never write
  # "housed in" — it reads as a campus unit.
  affiliation: >-
    A research program led by Dr. Tim Thomas, Assistant Researcher in the UC
    Berkeley Department of Sociology, which serves as its academic home.
    Affiliated with the Berkeley Institute for Data Science.
  copyright: "© 2026 Eviction Research Network · University of California, Berkeley"
  accessibility:
    label: "Report a web accessibility issue"
    href: "https://dap.berkeley.edu/get-help/report-web-accessibility-issue"
  columns:
    - heading: "Data"
      links:
        - label: "Maps &amp; profiles"
          href: "index.html#atlas"
        - label: "HPRM risk maps"
          href: "https://evictionresearch.net/hprm/"
          newtab: true
        - label: "U.S. Eviction Data Directory"
          href: "eviction-data-atlas.html"
          newtab: true
    - heading: "Research"
      links:
        - label: "Publications"
          href: "research.html"
        - label: "What works"
          href: "policy.html"
        - label: "Methodology"
          href: "methodology.html"
          newtab: true
        - label: "Understanding eviction"
          href: "understanding-eviction.html"
          newtab: true
        - label: "News &amp; press"
          href: "news.html"
          newtab: true
    - heading: "Contact"
      links:
        - label: "evictions@berkeley.edu"
          href: "mailto:evictions@berkeley.edu?Subject=Contact%20through%20website"
        - label: "Bluesky"
          href: "https://bsky.app/profile/evictionresearch.bsky.social"
          newtab: true
        - label: "LinkedIn"
          href: "https://www.linkedin.com/company/evictionresearch/"
          newtab: true
        - label: "GitHub"
          href: "https://github.com/evictionresearch"
          newtab: true

format: research-html
output-file: research.html
---
